title: Classic American Cornbread Casserole
description: A twist on the traditional cornbread, this casserole combines the flavors of America in a heartwarming dish.
instructions: Cook the sliced bacon in a skillet until crispy; set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the cornbread mix, shredded cheese, sour cream, eggs, sugar, salt, and black pepper. Stir until just combined.
Add the cooked bacon and chopped scallions to the cornbread mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
